svg.aria-label: Two lanes. Learn-to-Steer updates the latent itself up to 16 times per step at step size 5. Our sampler subtracts a capped push from the product's noise prediction once per step. Our hand-written attention-separation push drew two animals on 0 of 8 SDXL seeds.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: The same gradient can enter the sampler in two ways
Top: what Learn-to-Steer does on its models. Bottom: what our sampler does with a head today. SDXL with this head is our proposal.
Learn-to-Steer: move the latent itself, many times
step size 5 (SD 2.1, Flux), no cap stated
up to 16 updates per step in the code (15 printed)
Our sampler: change the noise prediction, once, with a cap
to at most c of the prediction's norm
shortened to at most c of its norm
the code's default c is 0.1; proposed: 0.4
Our own hand-written attention-separation push drew two animals on 0 of 8 SDXL seeds.
Seeds 9 to 16, steps 0 to 19, draft calls, no verdict recorded. It used a correlation loss, so it does not test a trained head.
